# What it is
The Simulator lets you run your program without a kit. It shows a virtual robot or a virtual IoT board next to your blocks.

# Using it
Open the Simulator tab in the run panel and press Run. For the robot you can place walls and a black line on the simulator floor. For IoT you can drag a slider to change the temperature or light level.

# Simulator versus a real kit
The simulator is perfect for testing ideas, but it is not exact: real wheels drift and real sensors are noisy. Always test on the real kit before your final project. Use the speed slider to slow the simulation down and the reset button to start again.
